get.description: Downloads a file by returning an HTTP 302 redirect. The Location header points to the final download URL: a presigned URL for private files or a persistent direct URL for public files. No JSON body is returned. Security note: when following the redirect, clients should not forward custom credential headers such as x-api-key to a cross-origin destination. The Tier0 SDK already handles this behavior.

302.description: Redirect to the final download URL.

post.description: Initializes a multipart upload for large files (>100 MB). The server creates the multipart upload, reserves quota, and returns uploadId, partSize, and partCount.
Returns presigned PUT URLs for the requested parts so file data can be uploaded directly to object storage. Supports resumable uploads.
Completes a multipart upload. The server validates the authoritative uploaded size using ListParts, reconciles any quota difference, and changes the upload from temporary to active.
Aborts a multipart upload, removes remaining uploaded parts, and releases the reserved quota.

Creates a standard MQTT Auth credential equivalent to one created manually in the UI. The password is returned only once in the successful creation response and should be stored securely immediately. This OpenAPI does not provide an endpoint to retrieve or return the password again. Only full_access API Keys can call this endpoint.

Idempotently deletes a standard MQTT Auth credential. Nonexistent, already deleted, or non-standard credential IDs return success and do not delete system credentials such as Flow or EdgeNode credentials. Only full_access API Keys can call this endpoint.

bindFlowID.description: Bound Source Flow ID. 0 means no Source Flow is bound.

bindEventFlowID.description: Bound Event Flow ID. 0 means no Event Flow is bound.

aborted.description: Abort result: 1 = aborted (including idempotent replay success), 2 = not aborted.
